results.title: GBS Rapid Sensor: Real-time testing when it matters most - Nexsen
results.content: # GBS Rapid Sensor: Real-time testing when it matters most. A breakthrough point-of-care diagnostic, enabling rapid detection of Group B Streptococcus. The GBS Rapid Sensor delivers lab-level sensitivity and specificity in minutes through a simple vaginal-rectal swab with results visible on the strip just like a pregnancy test or COVID test. Group B Streptococcus (GBS) affects 1 in 4 pregnant women and is a leading cause of newborn infections. ## How the GBS Rapid Sensor Works. The GBS Rapid Sensor uses a vaginal-rectal swab on the day of labour and delivers results in minutes through a pregnancy-test-style strip. Results appear visibly on the strip in minutes, enabling fast, informed clinical decisions at the point of care. The GBS Rapid Sensor™ is on a promising path toward clinical implementation. The GBS Rapid Sensor is on a promising path toward clinical implementation. Nexsen’s commercial strategy targets jurisdictions with high birth volumes, reimbursement pathways, and strong clinical readiness. Estimated GBS Rapid Sensor tests required per pregnancy.
